fix: Load the JWT signing secret from an environment variable or secret manager and rotate the leaked value.
Use a parameterized query such as WHERE title LIKE $1 with the value '%' + q + '%' passed in the params array.
Use res.sendFile(path.basename(req.params.name), { root: REPORT_DIR }) or verify the resolved path stays inside REPORT_DIR.
Hash passwords with a salted, slow algorithm such as argon2id, bcrypt or scrypt instead of unsalted MD5.
Validate the URL against an allow-list of hosts and block private, loopback and link-local addresses, with redirects disabled.
Require requireAdmin or check that the ticket belongs to req.user before deleting it.
Validate format against a fixed allow-list and call execFile with an argument array instead of exec with string interpolation.
